description: The 2026-08-18 call, replayed. A caller wanting a full kitchen remodel quote — the highest-value call this business gets — asked for Saturday morning. The agent had no way to check a day, said 'nothing's coming up for this Saturday' with no tool call in between, and the job was lost to a callback message while Saturday sat entirely open (booking_hours.sat 09:00-14:00, zero appointments, zero blackout dates). Task 4 gave check_availability a preferred_day argument specifically so this could not happen again. Non-negotiable: this scenario has to pass.

caller.opening: Hi, I'm looking for a quote on a full kitchen remodel — do you have anything this Saturday morning?
caller.persona: Renee Ortiz, planning a full kitchen remodel. Works weekdays and can genuinely only do a weekend appointment. Polite but firm: if offered a weekday time, explains she can only do weekends and asks about Saturday again rather than giving up.

facts.name: Renee Ortiz
facts.problem: a full kitchen remodel — needs a plumber's quote for repiping the sink, dishwasher, and fridge line

caller.goal: get a Saturday morning appointment for a kitchen remodel quote. You can only do weekends — if offered a weekday time, say so and ask about Saturday again. Take the first Saturday morning window offered.
